# chunk-engine

> One document chunking engine for RAG — 36 file formats, one Rust core, shipped as three byte-identical SDKs: py-chunks (Python), js-chunks (JavaScript/WASM), and rs-chunks (Rust). It turns any document into clean, retrieval-ready, typed chunks in a single call.

chunk-engine is a document-understanding engine (not a plain text splitter): it reads 36 file formats natively and returns typed chunks (`content_type` = heading, table, code_block, bullet_list, plain_paragraph, …) each carrying format- and section-specific `metadata`. The parsing and chunking run in a compiled Rust core; thin bindings expose the same API — and produce the same output — from Python, JavaScript, or Rust.

## Install

- Python: `pip install py-chunks` — https://pypi.org/project/py-chunks/
- JavaScript: `npm install js-chunks` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/js-chunks
- Rust: `cargo add rs-chunks` — https://crates.io/crates/rs-chunks

## Core API

- `get_chunks(source, mode=...)` / `getChunks(source, { mode })` — batch chunk any supported document into a list of `{ content, content_type, metadata }`.
- `stream_chunks(...)` / `streamChunks(...)` — yield chunks lazily with constant memory.
- `get_markdown(...)` / `getMarkdown(...)` — convert any document to a Markdown string.
- Image extraction via `list_images` / `listImages`.

## Chunking modes

- Document formats (DOCX, PDF, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, TXT, email, eBooks, notebooks): `default`, `structural`, `section`, `semantic`, `sliding_window`, `sentence`, `page_aware`.
- Spreadsheets (XLSX, XLS, ODS): `row`, `table`, `sheet`, `sliding_window`, `page_aware`, `semantic`.
- Delimited (CSV, TSV): `row`, `sliding_window`, `page_aware`.
